description: This file contains shell script functions and configurations for managing mac80211 wireless interfaces, including setup, configuration, capabilities, and driver management for wireless devices in a Linux environment.

methods.name: wdev_tool
methods.description: Wrapper function to execute ucode with specific arguments.

methods.name: ubus_call
methods.description: Wrapper for calling ubus commands with locking.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_init_device_config
methods.description: Initializes device configuration for mac80211 driver.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_init_iface_config
methods.description: Initializes interface configuration for mac80211 driver.

methods.name: mac80211_add_capabilities
methods.description: Adds capabilities to a variable based on provided masks and capabilities.

methods.name: mac80211_add_he_capabilities
methods.description: Adds HE (High Efficiency) capabilities based on hardware info.

methods.name: mac80211_hostapd_setup_base
methods.description: Sets up base configuration for hostapd for a given phy.

methods.name: mac80211_hostapd_setup_bss
methods.description: Sets up BSS configuration for hostapd.

methods.name: mac80211_get_addr
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address for a given phy and index.

methods.name: mac80211_generate_mac
methods.description: Generates a MAC address for a given phy.

methods.name: get_board_phy_name
methods.description: Gets the physical interface name from board JSON based on path.

methods.name: rename_board_phy_by_path
methods.description: Renames phy based on board JSON path.

methods.name: rename_board_phy_by_name
methods.description: Renames phy based on board JSON name.

methods.name: find_phy
methods.description: Finds and renames phy based on various identifiers.

methods.name: mac80211_check_ap
methods.description: Checks if an AP interface exists.

methods.name: mac80211_set_ifname
methods.description: Sets interface name with prefix and index.

methods.name: mac80211_prepare_vif
methods.description: Prepares virtual interface configuration.

methods.name: get_freq
methods.description: Gets frequency for a given phy, channel, and band.

methods.name: chan_is_dfs
methods.description: Checks if a channel is DFS (radar detection).

methods.name: mac80211_set_noscan
methods.description: Sets noscan flag for hostapd.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_cleanup
methods.description: Cleanup function for driver (empty).

methods.name: mac80211_reset_config
methods.description: Resets configuration for a phy.

methods.name: mac80211_set_suffix
methods.description: Sets suffixes for phy and vif based on radio.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_setup
methods.description: Main setup function for mac80211 driver, configuring interfaces, channels, and drivers.

methods.name: list_phy_interfaces
methods.description: Lists network interfaces associated with a phy.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_teardown
methods.description: Teardown function for driver, resets config.

methods.name: add_driver
methods.description: Registers the mac80211 driver.
